sql: SELECT TOP 10 pr.ProfileId AS profileId, pr.ProfileName AS profileName FROM dbo.ZnodePortal p INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalProfile pp ON pp.PortalId = p.PortalId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeProfile pr ON pr.ProfileId = pp.ProfileId WHERE p.StoreCode = @store AND pr.ProfileName = @profile ORDER BY pr.ProfileId
